WTIO21 PGTW 251100
MSGID/GENADMIN/JOINT TYPHOON WRNCEN PEARL HARBOR HI//
SUBJ/TROPICAL CYCLONE FORMATION ALERT (INVEST 98B) REISSUED//
REF/A/JOINT TYPHOON WRNCEN PEARL HARBOR HI/241051Z OCT 26//
AMPN/REF IS TROPICAL CYCLONE FORMATION ALERT (WTIO21 PGTW 241100)//
RMKS/
1. FORMATION OF A SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL CYCLONE IS POSSIBLE WITHIN
120 NM EITHER SIDE OF A LINE FROM 15.8N 91.1E TO 16.0N 87.3E
WITHIN THE NEXT 12 TO 24 HOURS. AVAILABLE DATA DOES NOT JUSTIFY
ISSUANCE OF NUMBERED TROPICAL CYCLONE WARNINGS AT THIS TIME.
WINDS IN THE AREA ARE ESTIMATED TO BE 28 TO 33 KNOTS. METSAT
IMAGERY AT 250600Z INDICATES THAT A CIRCULATION CENTER IS LOCATED
NEAR 15.8N 90.9E. THE SYSTEM IS MOVING WESTWARD AT 03 KNOTS.
2. REMARKS: THE AREA OF CONVECTION (INVEST 98B) PREVIOUSLY LOCATED
NEAR 15.8N 91.2E IS NOW LOCATED NEAR 15.8N 90.9E, APPROXIMATELY
272NM NORTH-NORTHWEST OF PORT BLAIR, INDIA. MULTISPECTRAL SATELLITE 
IMAGERY (MSI) DEPICTS A RAPIDLY CONSOLIDATING LOW-LEVEL CIRCULATION 
CENTER (LLCC), CURVED CONVECTIVE BANDING, AND FLARING CONVECTION NEAR 
THE CENTER. A 250746Z GMI MICROWAVE IMAGE REVEALS FORMATION OF A PARTIAL 
INNER CORE WITH CONVECTIVE BANDS WRAPPING INTO THE CENTER. ENVIRONMENTAL 
ANALYSIS INDICATES HIGHLY FAVORABLE CONDITIONS FOR DEVELOPMENT WITH LOW 
VERTICAL WIND SHEAR (10-15KTS), MODERATE TO STRONG POLEWARD AND WESTWARD 
UPPER-LEVEL OUTFLOW, AND VERY WARM SEA SURFACE TEMPERATURES (29-30C). 
THE RECENT RAPID IMPROVEMENT IN THE CONVECTIVE STRUCTURE OBSERVED IN MSI 
AND OUTPUT FROM GLOBAL DETERMINISTIC AND ENSEMBLE MODELS SUPPORT HIGH 
CONFIDENCE OF TROPICAL CYCLONE FORMATION WITHIN 12 HOURS. MAXIMUM 
SUSTAINED SURFACE WINDS ARE ESTIMATED AT 28 TO 33 KNOTS. MINIMUM SEA 
LEVEL PRESSURE IS ESTIMATED TO BE NEAR 1002 MB. THE POTENTIAL FOR THE 
DEVELOPMENT OF A SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL CYCLONE WITHIN THE NEXT 24 HOURS 
REMAINS HIGH. THIS SUPERSEDES REF A (WTIO21 PGTW 241100).
3. THIS ALERT WILL BE REISSUED, UPGRADED TO WARNING OR CANCELLED BY 
261100Z.//
NNNN
